name: O.Translator
tagline: AI document translation with layout preservation
description: O.Translator is an online AI document translation service for PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and EPUB files. It helps users translate documents while retaining their layout and supports scanned documents through OCR. Pricing uses pay-as-you-go credits based on tokens, document analysis and the selected translation mode. Preview availability and scope depend on the document and account allowance, and some previews consume credits. Users can review the displayed task quote before paying for full translation.
